title: Sticker Spite
tagline: Remove the label. Leave no grudge.
concept: Carefully peel stubborn stickers from tiny objects without tearing them or leaving gummy scraps behind.
core_loop: Grab the oversized tab, pull through the visible low-stress direction, and adjust or pause when the edge turns amber; each 5–15 second peel offers controlled risk followed by the satisfaction of a spotless reveal.
mechanics: Controls: Drag the tab in any direction with touch or mouse and release to pause; on keyboard, use the arrow keys to aim and hold Space to pull.; Win/lose: Fully clean each object to advance; a tear leaves a new reachable tab but wrinkles one of three sticker icons, and the run ends when all three are wrinkled.; Scoring: Earn points for clean area and intact removals, with a growing combo for consecutive tear-free stickers; pauses never reduce the score.
feedback: A clean peel curls into a neat roll with a soft zip, a bright shine across the object, and a crisp score burst. Dangerous tension turns the edge amber, stretches the sticker, and adds a faint crackle; releasing visibly relaxes it. A tear flashes a red split, leaves obvious residue, wrinkles a life icon, and makes a dry ripping sound, while a near-miss wobble and green directional chevrons show how
difficulty: The first minute uses large tabs, flat objects, broad safe pulling angles, and slowly rising stress.
